prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Asset type: standalone Russian B2B catalogue product illustration, photorealistic.
Primary request: One compact neatly wound coil of black jacketed three-core copper cable, nominal specification 3 × 2.5 mm² and length 100 m. The coil consists of many smooth round black cable loops, secured discreetly without branded packaging. A short cable end extends from the coil in the foreground: black outer jacket is stripped back briefly, showing exactly THREE insulated conductors in brown, blue and yellow-green, each with a small copper tip. Keep the three conductors clearly countable and structurally realistic.
Scene/backdrop: clean seamless off-white studio background, #f8f8f6, subtle natural soft contact shadow.
Composition/framing: square 1:1 image, 1024 × 1024 if available. Whole single coil and short exposed end centered in three-quarter view, occupy about 75% of the frame, fully visible with clear margins.
Style/medium: realistic clean studio catalogue photography, believable matte black rubber/plastic jacket and copper details, soft diffuse lighting.
Constraints: authored synthetic product illustration, no real manufacturer or trademark. No other products, branded packaging, labels, text, numbers, voltage claims, logos, UI, watermarks, people, colored filter or crop.
